tests.name: 4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹
tests.assertion: test('4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹',()=>{for(const hp of[4500,4501]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,hp===4500?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],hp===4500);}});

tests.name: 4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦
tests.assertion: test('4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp:high?9000:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(high)c.hurt(c.t,7000,'回初快照降体','direct');else c.heal(c.t,9000,'回初快照回体','soul');c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],!high);}const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);});

tests.name: 4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合
tests.assertion: test('4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);});

tests.assertion: test('4940全部22招各16种子完整操作链HP/PP及原生2140首轮免麻痹；2492仅准备不等盾已知分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];if(m.id===29440)S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1,'known-unequal');turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});if(m.id===29440)S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1,'known-unequal');turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.immuneRound,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);}});

tests.assertion: test('4940/2161真实用招全弱且免弱失败授后两攻100%增伤，整招无效仍触发监听',()=>{const s=make(row(2161));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-1);timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,38516,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-2);const p=make(row(2161));timer(p,1,'免弱');turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,2);p.moveDefinitions[key(38516)].operations=[];turn(p,38516,20309);assert.ok(sum(p)>0);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,2);turn(p,null,20309);const damage=[];for(const n of[1,0,0]){turn(p,38516,20309);damage.push(sum(p));assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,n);}assert.ok(damage[0]>damage[2]*1.6&&damage[1]>damage[2]*1.6);});
